url.label: Application URL
url.description: The URL users access Attraccess at (used for redirects, links, and API callbacks).

publicInternetUrl.label: Public Internet URL
publicInternetUrl.description: Optional URL used for external callbacks (e.g. SumUp).

cookieSameSite.label: Cookie SameSite Policy
cookieSameSite.description: Controls when session cookies are sent with cross-site requests. 'Lax' is recommended for most setups.

lax.label: Lax (recommended)
lax.description: Cookies sent on top-level navigation. Works with SSO (OIDC / SAML).

strict.label: Strict
strict.description: Maximum isolation. Breaks SSO logins — IdP redirects will not carry the session cookie.

none.label: None
none.description: Cookies sent on all cross-site requests. Requires HTTPS (Secure flag).

licenseKey.label: License Key
licenseKey.description: Paste a new license key to update.
